ticketUp.title: TicketUp: Event Management and Ticket Selling Platform.
ticketUp.description: TicketUp is a comprehensive event management and ticket sales platform, consisting of three interconnected modules: Mobile Application, Web Administration Center (Organizers & Admins) and Central API (Secure Backend)
ticketUp.problem: Booking a seat for a concert or a festival still means a paper ticket sold at a handful of physical outlets: you have to travel, queue up, and counterfeit tickets circulate easily. On the organiser's side, entries are counted by hand — there is no way to know in real time how many seats are left, or who actually walked in.
ticketUp.solution: TicketUp digitises the whole chain. Organisers create and publish their event from a web back-office, the audience buys a ticket in seconds from the mobile app, and door control happens by scanning a unique QR code. A secure central API keeps the three modules in sync and gives the organiser live sales tracking.
features: Event creation and publishing from the organiser workspace
Ticket purchase from the mobile app in a few steps
Unique QR code per ticket, verified by scan at the door
Real-time dashboard: sales, remaining seats, validated entries
Role management (organiser / admin) and secure authentication
ticketUp.role: Designed the architecture of the three modules and built the central API (authentication, ticketing, access control) as well as the organiser back-office.

mySchool.title: MySchool: Complete School Management Application.
mySchool.description: The platform aims to make the high school education system easy. Facilitate communication, management, and improve the way of transmitting knowledge.
mySchool.problem: In many schools, grades, absences and timetables still live in notebooks and scattered spreadsheets. Parents discover how their child is doing once a term, on a paper report card, when it is already too late to react. Teachers, meanwhile, lose hours copying the same averages over and over.
mySchool.solution: MySchool brings administration, teachers, students and parents onto a single platform. Grades and absences entered once by the teacher automatically feed the report cards, and each parent follows their child's schooling in real time from their own space.
features: Four dedicated spaces: administration, teacher, student and parent
Grade entry, automatic averages and report card generation
Absence and lateness tracking, reported to parents
Management of classes, subjects and timetables
Internal messaging between the school and families
mySchool.role: Full-stack development: database modelling, business logic (grades, report cards, absences) and the interfaces of all four spaces.

ebookShare.title: E-bookShare: A way to share my favorite e-book to everyone.
ebookShare.description: e-BookShare is a web and mobile application that facilitates the sharing, discovery and borrowing of digital books, encouraging social reading and mutual aid between enthusiasts.
ebookShare.problem: Our best reads sit forgotten in a folder on our computer. When we want someone to discover a book, we end up sending files by email or on a USB stick, never knowing who read it or what we lent out. And buying every title gets expensive when you read a lot.
ebookShare.solution: e-BookShare turns those scattered personal libraries into a shared one: everyone makes their books available, borrows other members' books for a set period, and discovers new titles through the community's reviews.
features: Personal library: upload and catalogue your own e-books
Borrowing and returning between members, with a time limit
Search and discovery by genre, author or recommendation
Ratings, reviews and comments to encourage social reading
Web and mobile versions so you can read anywhere
ebookShare.role: Designed and built the web and mobile application, from the lending API through to the reading interfaces.
